mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, check how I feel, and sit on the edge of the bed before getting up.
mara.intention: Avoid rushing and assess whether I am well enough for the day.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into lounge pants and an evening sweater, and leave my work clothes untouched.
mara.intention: Keep self-care manageable and make the day feel deliberately lighter.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea with lemon and honey, carry the mug to the kitchen island, and eat yogurt with a banana while sitting quietly.
mara.intention: Settle my stomach and get something gentle into me.

mara.activity: Send a short message to the studio that I am ill and will not attend the site visits or meetings, then put my phone down and rinse the mug and glass.
mara.intention: Handle the necessary work communication without opening the door to a full workday.

mara.activity: Return to the bedroom and rest in bed with the lights low, keeping water nearby.
mara.intention: Let the early fatigue pass without trying to be productive.

mara.activity: Make a fresh mug of tea and quietly straighten only the kitchen island and sink area, then sit at the island.
mara.intention: Be useful to myself without overexerting or managing the whole house.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional, listening to nothing and watching the light change, with my phone nearby in case the studio needs clarification.
mara.intention: Replace the usual work block with genuine recovery.

mara.activity: Prepare toast and scrambled eggs slowly at the kitchen island, then eat without trying to hold a conversation or make decisions.
mara.intention: Have a substantial but simple lunch while energy is available.

mara.activity: Carry the plate and skillet to the sink, wash them, and leave the kitchen counters clear enough for the evening.
mara.intention: Prevent a small amount of cleanup from becoming a later burden.

mara.activity: Take a long quiet rest in the main bedroom, dozing if I can and keeping the phone on silent.
mara.intention: Conserve energy rather than attempt desk work or household planning.

mara.activity: Wake, drink water, take cold medicine if needed according to the label, and sit briefly before deciding what is realistic for dinner.
mara.intention: Check symptoms without making a series of unnecessary decisions.

mara.activity: Move to the living room and read a few pages of my paperback book, stopping when the words stop holding together.
mara.intention: Have a low-demand activity that is not work or screen-based.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea and set out a plate, mug, and water glass for later, leaving a simple note to myself that dinner can be toast and eggs again if necessary.
mara.intention: Make the evening easier while I still have a little energy.

mara.activity: Rest on the living room sectional, keeping the room quiet and answering only essential messages.
mara.intention: Stay available without resuming work or taking responsibility for the evening's larger rhythm.

mara.activity: Prepare a very simple dinner of toast and scrambled eggs at the island, then eat seated there rather than setting the dining table.
mara.intention: Follow the easiest nourishing option and abandon the usual more deliberate cooking routine.

mara.activity: Rinse the dinner things, wipe the island, and leave anything that needs more attention for tomorrow.
mara.intention: Do a small reset without spending the remaining energy on a full cleanup.

mara.activity: Rest in the living room with the lights softer, drinking water and allowing Julian to have his own evening schedule without asking for updates or managing him.
mara.intention: Be quietly independent while accepting that ordinary companionship may be limited tonight.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, change into sleep pants and a sleep shirt, and put my phone on its charger.
mara.intention: Move toward bed before I become overtired.

mara.activity: Make one last mug of ginger tea, carry it to the bedroom, and drink it while sitting quietly on the bed.
mara.intention: Soothe the lingering irritation in my throat and settle down.

mara.activity: Get into bed, place my reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, and read only a few pages before turning out the light.
mara.intention: End the day gently and protect the sleep needed for recovery.

mara.activity: Sleep.
mara.intention: Recover from the illness and let tomorrow remain undecided until morning.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes while quietly checking how she is feeling.
julian.intention: Start gently and assess whether Mara needs immediate practical help without hovering.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Follow my usual morning routine and be ready for the long workday.

julian.activity: Make tea with honey and a small yogurt-and-banana bowl, carrying the mug and bowl to the kitchen island. Set aside a covered portion for Mara if she wants it later, then check in with her briefly.
julian.intention: Offer something mild and easy while respecting Mara’s lack of appetite.

julian.activity: Rinse the mug and bowl, wipe the island, and review Monday’s restaurant notebook and receipts. Leave the notebook on the island with the receipts tucked inside.
julian.intention: Clear the breakfast things and gather my thoughts before ordering and payroll.

julian.activity: Pack my backpack with water, phone, reading glasses, tablet, and a paperback book; collect my keys from the piano’s middle shelf and put on my jacket.
julian.intention: Leave the house organized, with a way to contact Mara and something quiet for the transition between work blocks.

julian.activity: Travel to the restaurant and settle into the office.
julian.intention: Arrive with enough margin for the Monday paperwork.

julian.activity: Plan the menu, review stock, place supplier orders, and work through the most urgent Monday administration.
julian.intention: Complete the time-sensitive ordering work carefully rather than improvising.

julian.activity: Eat a simple lunch and drink water, keeping the break quiet while sending Mara a brief check-in message.
julian.intention: Keep my energy steady and make sure Mara knows I am reachable.

julian.activity: Finish payroll and staff administration, then make a short detailed list of anything still needing attention before dinner service.
julian.intention: Close the Monday office block cleanly and reduce the chance of carrying loose ends into service.

julian.activity: Return home, put the backpack beside the kitchen island, drink water, and check quietly on Mara. Ask whether she needs anything practical before I leave again.
julian.intention: Be present during the gap between work shifts without disrupting her rest.

julian.activity: Make a small pot of buttered noodles and leave a covered bowl on the kitchen island for Mara, then eat a little myself if she does not want it.
julian.intention: Provide familiar, low-effort food and make sure I am not going into service on an empty stomach.

julian.activity: Rinse the saucepan and bowl, pack the thermos with water, and change into my chef jacket and apron.
julian.intention: Reset the kitchen enough for Mara and prepare for dinner service.

julian.activity: Collect my backpack and keys, send Mara one final practical message, and leave for the restaurant.
julian.intention: Make the transition to service calmly while keeping communication open.

julian.activity: Prepare the kitchen and run dinner service, checking orders and staff needs while keeping the menu execution steady.
julian.intention: Work the scheduled service with focus and avoid bringing home more unfinished decisions than necessary.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen, and set it beside the sink. Drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table, then check that Mara is settled.
julian.intention: Come down from service and make a quiet, practical check-in.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep clothes without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Use my familiar post-service recovery routine and keep the house quiet.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of the noodles or yogurt from the refrigerator, drink water, put my phone on its charger, and return my wallet and earplugs to my pockets.
julian.intention: Settle my stomach and prepare for sleep with as little decision-making as possible.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara and sleep.
julian.intention: End the demanding day quietly and remain available if Mara needs me.
